item.title: 2026 Jeep Wrangler review
item.description: The Jeep Wrangler has been on sale in Australia for 30 years, but does it still have something to offer in this ever-changing market?

item.title: Lotus Eletre X plug-in hybrid heading to the UK, but Australia yet to be confirmed
item.description: The Lotus Eletre plug-in hybrid is heading for Europe and the UK later this year, but Australian availability is still unclear.

item.title: Ford Mustang manual will be pulled “out of our cold dead hands”, says CEO
item.description: Ford's CEO told Australian media the Blue Oval will stubbornly keep making its six-speed manual Mustang for as long as possible.

item.title: 2026 BMW iX3 priced: First Neue Klasse EV undercuts key rivals by thousands
item.description: Australian pricing has been revealed for the all-new BMW iX3 electric SUV, which ushers in the brand’s next-generation Neue Klasse era.

item.title: 2026 BMW iX3 price and specs
item.description: The second-generation BMW iX3 is due here midway through 2026, launching in a single all-wheel drive variant priced at $109,900 before on-roads.

item.title: 2026 Cupra Formentor VZ5 prices: Hot five-pot SUV is brand's most expensive model yet
item.description: The Formentor VZ5 is Cupra's first model in Australia with a drive-away price north of $100,000, but it packs a punch.

item.title: Relaxing of state drug-driving laws proposed for medicinal cannabis users – report
item.description: The NSW Government is considering easing driving laws for those with medicinal cannabis prescriptions, but road safety advocates are concerned.

item.title: Australian Government won't cut fuel excise despite soaring prices
item.description: The federal government won't reduce the fuel excise from its current level, and has warned fuel retailers against price gouging.

item.title: Audi says its new 'radical' design language will set it apart from rivals
item.description: The German brand’s Concept C sports car will start a design renaissance which will filter down to all models – and set its vehicles apart.

item.title: Lamborghini CEO leaves door open for more off-road sports cars
item.description: Lamborghini boss Stephan Winkelmann waited a decade to do the Huracán Sterrato, but he's open to launching a successor.
